tools.name: onesearch
tools.description: Search the web privately with OneSearch, our own search engine: no tracking, no profile. scope "web" (default) returns web results with matching Niche of One network pages first; scope "network" searches only our eight sites.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search published NoO Network passages by plain query terms.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read a NoO Network corpus page by exact canonical URL. Index-only entries contain published summaries.

tools.name: todays_issue
tools.description: Read the newest dated NoO Network entries and their publication date.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List everything NoO Network published since a date, newest first: title, date, one-line summary and link. Defaults to the last seven days.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Search existing NoO Network product listings by plain query terms.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Quote an exact published passage from NoO Network, with attribution and canonical URL; at most 80 words.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Recommend up to three things matched to interests the user states, from the Niche of One shop that NoO Network sells through and from affiliate partners. Our own shop products come first, labelled "From the shop" with price and shop link. An affiliate product, labelled "Partner pick" with an affilia

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Return a checkout link for one product in the Niche of One store that NoO Network sells through. Pass a product slug or title. A clear match returns its title, price, checkout link and product page; an unclear one returns up to three candidate products with no link. This tool never takes payment its

tools.name: which_book_first
tools.description: Return the published NoO Network beginner sequence and reading list. A goal selects a relevant step; it does not invent a book ranking.

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: What is playing now on GZS 197.7 OMVFM, the NoO Network station: track, show, up next and where to listen. Same data as radio_now.

tools.name: sunday_issue
tools.description: Members only. Read the newest members-only Sunday issue from nicheof.one, or an earlier one by number. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Members only. Search the nicheof.one members archive (older issues and Sunday issues) by plain query terms. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

tools.name: get_archive_issue
tools.description: Members only. Read one nicheof.one members archive issue by the slug search_archive returns. Needs a Backchannel sign-in.

tools.name: my_library
tools.description: Members. List the Niche of One products this signed-in member owns, plus titles their plan or pass includes, and which can be read here.

tools.name: read_library
tools.description: Members. Read a product from your own Niche of One library: contents, one section, or a search inside it. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: read_serial
tools.description: Read Niche of One fiction chapter by chapter. Free sample chapters for anyone; whole books for members who own them, with a bookmark. No title lists what can be read. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Members. Show this member's Niche of One plan, renewal date and owned products. Never shows an email address or order number.

tools.name: get_download
tools.description: Members. Get a 10-minute download link for one product this member owns.

tools.name: forget_me
tools.description: Members. Clear the bookmarks, reading progress and interests this server keeps for you. Shows what it will clear first; call again with confirm true to clear.

tools.name: course
tools.description: The Method, the free Niche of One field manual, as a course: lessons in order, each with an exercise. The first 3 lessons are open to anyone; the rest need a free Niche of One sign-in (no paid plan). No lesson named: the next one (signed-in progress is kept). list true: every lesson. Best shown as a

tools.name: course_submit
tools.description: Members. Mark a Method lesson done after its exercise. The answer is not stored; only that the lesson is done. Shows what it will record first; call again with confirm true.

tools.name: set_interests
tools.description: Members. Save the topics you want your personal brief built from (replaces the saved list; an empty list clears it). Shows what it will save first; call again with confirm true.

tools.name: my_brief
tools.description: Members. A short sectioned brief, like a mini paper: what is new on the Niche of One network and from the archive, matched to the interests you set. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: start_site_build
tools.description: A guided brief for a hand-built website from Niche of One: asks for what is missing one step at a time, then shows the brief and the published prices. Sends it only on a second call with confirm true. Contact details are not taken here. Best shown as a step-by-step artifact.

tools.name: underground_feed
tools.description: Members. Read the Underground wall as you see it on the site (all rooms you can read, or only people you follow). Like the site, it moves your last-visit marker.

tools.name: underground_room
tools.description: Members. Read one Underground room.

tools.name: underground_thread
tools.description: Members. Read one thread with its replies. Like the site, it marks that thread's notifications read.

tools.name: underground_member
tools.description: Members. A member's public profile and posts, as the site shows them to you.

tools.name: underground_notifications
tools.description: Members. Your replies, mentions and messages notifications.

tools.name: underground_my_space
tools.description: Members. Your own profile, space settings and the rooms you can post in.

tools.name: underground_messages
tools.description: Members. Your direct-message conversations, or one conversation by handle (opening it marks it read, as on the site).

tools.name: post_to_underground
tools.description: Members. Post on the Underground wall or in a room, as yourself, under the site's rules. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_comment
tools.description: Members. Reply to an Underground post. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_react
tools.description: Members. Spark (the site's quiet nod) a post, or take it back. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_follow
tools.description: Members. Follow or unfollow a member. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_send_message
tools.description: Members. Send a direct message to a member, where the site allows it. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_edit_space
tools.description: Members. Change your display name, bio, links, layout, who sees your name, or who may message you. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_pin
tools.description: Members. Pin or unpin your own post (or a reply in your own thread). Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: underground_delete_post
tools.description: Members. Delete one of your own posts, with its replies. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: reply_to_jd
tools.description: Members. Send a note to J.D. Forrest. A person reads it; nothing answers it automatically. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to commit.

tools.name: reader_library
tools.description: Members. The OneReader library on this account: purchases, your own files (titles only), shelves, tags and continue reading, with positions.

tools.name: reader_notes
tools.description: Members. List or search your OneReader highlights, notes and bookmarks, for one book or all books. Each has an id for editing.

tools.name: reader_note_save
tools.description: Members. Add a highlight, note or bookmark to a book in your OneReader library, or edit one of yours by id. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true to save.

tools.name: reader_export_notes
tools.description: Members. Your OneReader highlights, notes and bookmarks as Markdown, for one book or all. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: reader_set_position
tools.description: Members. Set where you are in a book (percent), synced to OneReader on every device. The newest position wins. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true to save.

tools.name: onewriter_drafts
tools.description: Members. List your OneWriter drafts and folders on this account, search them, or read one by id. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: save_to_onewriter
tools.description: Members. Create a OneWriter draft, or edit one of yours by id: title, folder (move), and text replaced or appended. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true and the preview_token it returned to save.

tools.name: send_highlight_to_draft
tools.description: Members. Append one of your OneReader highlights or notes (by id) to a OneWriter draft, or start a new draft with it. Shows a preview first; call again with confirm true to save.

tools.name: publish_draft
tools.description: Members. Publish one of your OneWriter drafts as a post on your Underground wall (or in a room you can post in), as yourself. It goes through the site's own posting rules and safety filter and is seen by members on the Underground; no public web page is made and nothing is emailed. Posts run up to 1

tools.name: outline_from_notes
tools.description: Members. Gather your OneReader highlights and notes on a topic or book so you can outline a post from them. Returns the notes; the outline is yours to write.

tools.name: mall_browse
tools.description: Walk the Niche of One Mall. No arguments: the floor plan (storefronts and departments). With filters: our products with price, rating and product page, or a partner storefront (makers, catalog, newsstand) with its disclosure. Details, reviews and the checkout link: mall_product.

tools.name: mall_product
tools.description: Everything on one Niche of One product page: description, price (fixed, pay what you want or free), rating and reviews, bundle contents, the bundles it is in, related products and the checkout link for the person to open. Takes a slug or a title. It never takes payment.

tools.name: mall_reviews
tools.description: Ratings and reviews for one Niche of One product, newest first. Says so plainly when there are none.

tools.name: mall_policy
tools.description: The store's refund policy, terms or privacy policy, as published.

tools.name: site_browse
tools.description: Open any public page of nicheof.one by its path ("/", "/academy/", "/shop/first-frequency/"): its text, the site navigation, the pages under it and what a visitor can do there. Long pages come in parts. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: network_map
tools.description: The Codex: how the Niche of One network fits together (rooms, guides, fiction, radio, characters) and what connects to what.

tools.name: roster
tools.description: The Niche of One roster: staff, bands and cast, with roles and short bios.

tools.name: plans_info
tools.description: What the Niche of One membership plans include, as the plans page states it. Facts only; there is no checkout here.

tools.name: shows_browse
tools.description: The network's audio shows and their episodes: titles, dates, descriptions and audio links.

tools.name: academy_browse
tools.description: The Academy's courses, or one course's lessons in order, with which lessons are free to read.

tools.name: academy_lesson
tools.description: Read one Academy lesson. Free lessons are open to anyone; member lessons say what unlocks them. Long text: best shown to the user as a document or artifact.

tools.name: tools_list
tools.description: The free tools on nicheof.one, what each one does, and which can be run here.

tools.name: tool_run
tools.description: Run one of the site's calculators with the same formulas as its page: gumroad-fee-calculator {salePrice, affiliatePct?, discover?}, platform-rent-calculator {units, price}, tool-cost-killer {tools: [{name?, cost, seats?, billing: Monthly|Annual|One-time, status?: keep|kill}]}. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: radio_now
tools.description: What is on GZS 197.7 OMVFM, the Ground Zero Sum station, and where to listen.

tools.name: radio_schedule
tools.description: The GZS 197.7 OMVFM show schedule, as the station page lists it.

tools.name: radio_history
tools.description: Recently played tracks on GZS 197.7 OMVFM, when the station feed is available here.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "network" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, todays_issue, sunday_issue, search_archive, get_archive_issue, underground_feed, underground_thread, underground_messages, mall_browse, mall_product · Private data: read_library, read_serial, course_submit, my_brief, start_site_build, reader_library, reader_export_notes, onewriter_drafts, site_browse, academy_lesson · Public sink: buy, my_account, course_submit, underground_my_space, post_to_underground, underground_comment, underground_react, underground_send_message, underground_pin, underground_delete_post, reply_to_jd, send_highlight_to_draft, publish_draft, outline_from_notes · Destructive: underground_delete_post, publish_draft, tools_list, tool_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, todays_issue, sunday_issue, search_archive, get_archive_issue, underground_feed, underground_thread, underground_messages, mall_browse, mall_product · Private data: read_library, read_serial, course_submit, my_brief, start_site_build, reader_library, reader_export_notes, onewriter_drafts, site_browse, academy_lesson · Public sink: buy, my_account, course_submit, underground_my_space, post_to_underground, underground_comment, underground_react, underground_send_message, underground_pin, underground_delete_post, reply_to_jd, send_highlight_to_draft, publish_draft, outline_from_notes · Destructive: underground_delete_post, publish_draft, tools_list, tool_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
